comments: One bank on the lantern's foot (centre of the brass base, not of the crop, so the left handle does not shift it): one scale for all seven frames; the tall flames set it, the handle fits the 16 px canvas.

A reviewed ink grade keeps the lantern's brass and flame: the palette snap sent a few dark orange pixels to the signal red (a8341f), a stray red fleck at the chimney; the grade maps that one shared ink to the nearest admitted amber-brown (924f1d). No pixel is moved, added or removed.
geometry: The lantern flame item rises out of its block over 16 ticks then idles; the rules box is 10x14 at the anchor; art never sets a hitbox.
mapping_basis: Visual review of the delivered sheet and its measured crops, 2026-10-18. Reading order equals the request order: rise-0..3 (a bead of flame grows to full), idle-0..2 (tall, short left, fat right).
